title: VulnerableLightApp
description: VulnerableLightApp: a deliberately vulnerable .NET 10 REST and GraphQL API with about thirty CWE-mapped flaws, from SQL injection, XXE and insecure deserialization to JWT forgery, SSRF, command injection and a backdoor.
question: Use the API's arbitrary file read (or its command injection) to read /ctf/flag on the server.
